en.title: Tech News Roundup: Nvidia, Apple, OpenAI, and SpaceX Updates
en.summary: This week's major tech updates include **Jensen Huang** reportedly considering a return to Nvidia, Apple planning its **first smart glasses** for 2027, and OpenAI dissolving its **independent robotics team** to integrate researchers into core departments.
en.full_summary:
## Nvidia and Apple Updates
According to Financial Times, allies of **Jensen Huang** are pressuring Nvidia's board to have him return as CEO, though he lacks a controlling stake. Meanwhile, Bloomberg reports Apple plans to release its **first AI smart glasses** in June 2027, codenamed N50, acting as an AI assistant driven by Siri rather than a standalone AR display.

## OpenAI and Huawei Moves
OpenAI confirmed it has **dissolved its robotics research team**, reallocating staff to core research and applied divisions to accelerate R-development, despite active hiring earlier this year. Concurrently, Huawei announced it will release its **first Ascend-native embodied world model**, CloudRoboWM1.2, aiming to scale embodied AI across industries.

zh.title: 科技早报：黄仁勋被传考虑重返英伟达，苹果计划推首款智能眼镜
zh.summary: 本周科技圈动态频频：据称**黄仁勋**正考虑重返英伟达担任 CEO；苹果计划在 2027 年发布首款**智能眼镜**；而 OpenAI 则突然撤销了**独立机器人研究团队**，将人员并入核心部门。
zh.full_summary:
## 英伟达与苹果动态
据《金融时报》报道，**黄仁勋**的硅谷盟友正向英伟达董事会施压，希望他能重新担任公司 CEO，但由于他没有控股股份，最终决定权仍在于董事会。与此同时，彭博社透露苹果计划在 2027 年 6 月的 WWDC 上发布首款 **AI 智能眼镜**，主打 Siri 语音交互和环境感知，需要搭配 iPhone 使用。

## 行业其他进展
OpenAI 向媒体确认已**撤销独立机器人研究团队**，原有人员被分流至核心研究与应用部门以加快研发进度。此外，华为云宣布将于近日发布首款**昇腾原生具身世界模型**，推动具身智能技术的规模化落地。

en.title: AI Meets America's New World: Why Data Centers Face a Wave of Delays and Backlash
en.summary: Following the US midterms, a shift in the AI narrative and growing regulatory pressure have triggered a stock market sell-off. Industry experts and Wall Street investors warn that **data center delays** are now all but guaranteed, driven by local resident pushback, rising infrastructure costs, and tighter permit reviews. While long-term demand remains strong, the immediate bottleneck in **supply and policy hurdles** could increase total project costs by 10% to 20%, forcing the industry to adapt to a more complex political landscape.
en.full_summary:
The recent US midterm elections have reshaped the political and economic landscape surrounding artificial intelligence, shining a spotlight on the friction between tech expansion and local communities. With Democrats gaining control of both houses of Congress and key regional shifts, such as Gina Hinojosa winning the Texas governorship, the approval process for massive data center projects has hit significant roadblocks. ## Key Details
Industry insiders note that public pushback is no longer a secondary concern; it has become a primary risk factor. Residents are increasingly worried about rising utility bills, water scarcity, and environmental impacts. Although large tech companies and cloud providers are willing to shoulder grid and water system upgrades, the extended legislative cycles, potential tax burdens, and strict local negotiations could drive up overall data center construction costs by 10% to 20%. Furthermore, rigorous permit requirements, such as air pollution and grid interconnection approvals, threaten to delay or even cancel planned projects over the next year.

## Industry Impact
Despite supply-side slowdowns and a volatile market reaction that has hammered upstream hardware stocks, tech executives argue that **underlying computing demand** remains exceptionally high. Hyperscalers continue to report massive order backlogs, and token consumption metrics show robust growth. However, the short-term mismatch between planned infrastructure and actual deployment timelines will force the industry to re-evaluate capital expenditures, potentially shifting pricing power to existing data center operators while squeezing upstream suppliers.

zh.title: AI撞上美国“新世界”：数据中心为何面临延迟与反对浪潮
zh.summary: 美国中期选举后，AI叙事的改变和监管压力导致股市出现抛售。行业专家与华尔街投资人警告称，受当地居民反对、基础设施成本上升及更严的审批审查影响，**数据中心延期**几乎已成定局。尽管长期需求依然强劲，但当前的**供给瓶颈与政策阻碍**可能会使项目总成本增加10%至20%，迫使行业适应更加复杂的政治环境。
zh.full_summary:
美国中期选举彻底改变了围绕人工智能的政治与经济格局，将技术扩张与地方社区之间的矛盾推到了聚光灯下。随着民主党赢得国会参众两院控制权，加之德州等关键地区政坛变动，大规模数据中心项目的审批流程遇到了重大阻碍。

## 关键细节
行业业内人士指出，公众的反对已不再是次要因素，而是演变成了核心风险。当地居民对电费上涨、水资源短缺以及环境影响的担忧日益加剧。尽管大型科技公司和云厂商愿意承担电网和供水系统的升级费用，但漫长的立法周期、潜在的税收负担以及严格的地方谈判，可能会使数据中心整体建设成本增加10%至20%。此外，空气污染和电网并网等严格的许可证审批要求，也面临着在未来一年内导致项目延迟甚至取消的风险。

## 行业影响
尽管供给端增速放缓以及市场波动打击了上游硬件股票，但行业高管认为，**底层的算力需求**依然异常旺盛。各大云厂商手握巨额订单，Token消耗量也显示出强劲增长。然而，基础设施规划与实际落地时间表之间的短期错配，将迫使整个行业重新评估资本开支，这可能在短期内让现有数据中心运营商获得更强的定价权，同时对上游供应商形成压力。

en.title: Novo’s CagriSema drives more than 20% weight loss at lower doses
en.summary: Novo Nordisk presented new data at ObesityWeek showing that lower doses of its next-gen obesity drug **CagriSema achieved over 20% weight loss** in a Phase 3 trial. This development helps rebuild confidence as the company **awaits a crucial FDA decision** by the end of the year, following earlier investor disappointments.
en.full_summary:
## Clinical Trial Results
Novo Nordisk reported data from the Phase 3 REDEFINE 9 trial at the ObesityWeek 2026 conference. Patients receiving weekly doses of 1 mg and 1.7 mg of **CagriSema lost 21% and 20.7% of their body weight**, respectively, at week 68. These findings demonstrate that meaningful efficacy can be achieved below the previously studied highest dose.

## Background and Market Context
CagriSema combines the amylin analog cagrilintide and the GLP-1 receptor agonist semaglutide. Earlier data from the REDEFINE 1 trial showed 22.7% weight loss at higher doses, which initially disappointed investors who had expected even higher figures. Despite previous setbacks, including failing to beat Eli Lilly’s Zepbound in a head-to-head test, Novo Nordisk continues to position the drug as a major next-generation therapy.

## Regulatory Outlook and Tolerability
The latest findings form part of a broader data presentation as the drug **awaits a U.S. FDA decision** expected by the end of 2026. Analysts noted that tolerability remained consistent with previous studies, showing common side effects such as nausea and vomiting, while the company prepares to leverage its extensive clinical data to enter the market.

zh.title: 诺和诺德减肥新药CagriSema在较低剂量下实现超20%减重效果
zh.summary: 诺和诺德在ObesityWeek上公布了新数据，显示其下一代减肥药CagriSema在较低剂量下**实现了超20%的减重效果**。此前该药曾让投资者失望，随着年底**美国FDA审批决定**临近，这组新数据有助于重新提振市场信心。
zh.full_summary:
## 临床试验结果
诺和诺德在2026年ObesityWeek会议上公布了REDEFINE 9三期临床试验的数据。结果显示，在第68周时，接受每周1毫克和1.7毫克剂量CagriSema治疗的患者，**体重分别减轻了21%和20.7%**。这表明该药物在低于先前研究的最高剂量时，依然能够带来显著的疗效。

## 背景与市场动态
CagriSema是一种将胰淀素类似物cagrilintide与GLP-1受体激动剂司美格鲁肽结合的复合制剂。此前REDEFINE 1试验显示高剂量组可实现22.7%的减重，由于未能达到部分投资者过高的预期而引发股价波动。尽管此前曾在一场直接对比中未能战胜礼来的Zepbound，诺和诺德仍将其视为下一代核心减肥疗法。

## 监管前景与耐受性
随着该药**等待美国FDA的审批决定**（预计于2026年底得出），诺和诺德在会议上密集发布了多项数据以支持其市场定位。分析指出，该药的耐受性特征与此前试验类似，恶心和呕吐仍是常见的不良反应，公司正借此建立医生对该新机制药物的熟悉度。

en.title: US tightens AI chip export controls to deter Chinese companies from accessing compute remotely
en.summary: The Trump administration is introducing **new export controls** to stop companies in restricted countries like China from bypassing rules by remotely accessing AI data centers abroad. Under this interim rule, any global data center providing high-level computing power must obtain a license if it serves restricted nations, while also expanding restrictions to **several Southeast Asian nations and Brazil** to prevent diversion.
en.full_summary:
## Background
The U.S. Commerce Department is rolling out an interim rule designed to close loopholes in existing export restrictions. Previously, rules required licenses only for shipping chips directly to companies in embargoed countries like China, Russia, Iran, and North Korea. However, companies have increasingly turned to **remote-access loopholes**, using overseas data centers to train advanced models.

## Key Details
The new rule applies to any data center or network exceeding a specific computing power metric of 12 million total processing performance, roughly equivalent to about 750 Nvidia H100 or H200 chips. Operators must obtain licenses within 90 days if they serve customers from restricted countries. Additionally, the rule introduces new licensing requirements for semiconductor transfers to Malaysia, Singapore, Indonesia, Thailand, and Brazil due to a **higher risk of diversion**, though chips destined for U.S.-based companies in these nations are exempt. The framework also rescinds the previous administration's AI Diffusion Rule.

## Industry Impact
This regulatory shift forces global cloud and data center operators to strictly monitor customer ownership structures and network access. It comes in the wake of heightened scrutiny over Chinese firms scrambling for overseas compute capacity and aims to block actors from leveraging U.S. advanced semiconductors for intelligence-related or military activities.

zh.title: 美国收紧人工智能芯片出口管制，防止中国企业远程获取算力
zh.summary: 美国政府正在推出**全新的出口管制**措施，旨在阻止中国等受限国家的企业通过远程访问海外人工智能数据中心来绕过规则。根据这项临时规定，任何提供高水平算力的全球数据中心，如果向受限国家提供服务就必须获得许可证，同时该规定还将限制范围扩大到了**东南亚多国和巴西**以防止芯片被转运。
zh.full_summary:
## 背景
美国商务部正准备推出一项临时规定，旨在堵住现有出口限制中的漏洞。此前，相关规则仅要求向中国、俄罗斯、伊朗和朝鲜等受限国家的企业直接发运芯片时必须申请许可证。然而，一些企业越来越多地转向**远程访问漏洞**，通过海外的数据中心来训练先进的模型。

## 关键细节
新规适用于算力超过1200万总处理性能指标的数据中心或网络，这大致相当于约750个英伟达H100或H200芯片的最大算力。如果这些数据中心服务于受限国家的客户，必须在90天内获得许可证。此外，由于**转运风险较高**，该规则对向马来西亚、新加坡、印尼、泰国和巴西传输半导体增设了新的许可要求，但目的地为这些国家美国企业的芯片则可豁免。该框架还正式废除了上一届政府的AI扩散规则。

## 行业影响
这一监管变动迫使全球云服务和数据中心运营商严格审查客户的股权结构和网络访问情况。出台此举正值外界高度关注中国企业争相争夺海外算力之际，旨在阻止相关方利用美国先进半导体开展军事或情报相关活动。

en.title: ULA's Vulcan rocket suffers first failure during Amazon satellite launch
en.summary: United Launch Alliance's **new Vulcan rocket** suffered its first complete failure during a flight carrying 40 Amazon internet satellites, destroying the payload and disrupting **launch schedules**. The mishap occurred 10 minutes into the flight during the upper stage operation, marking the first outright failure for ULA since its formation in 2006.
en.full_summary:
## Background and Incident Details
United Launch Alliance launched its heavy-lift Vulcan rocket from Cape Canaveral, carrying the first batch of 38 contracted flights for Amazon's Leo internet constellation. Approximately 10 minutes into the flight, during the operation of the hydrogen-fueled Centaur upper stage, an anomaly occurred that prevented the vehicle from delivering the payload to orbit. ULA confirmed the failure and announced it would work with customers to investigate the root cause.

## Impact and Industry Consequences
This marks the first outright failure for ULA since its inception as a Boeing and Lockheed Martin joint venture in 2006. The Vulcan fleet will likely face a **significant grounding** while engineers review telemetry data and implement corrective actions. The setback also affects Amazon's Leo constellation deployment, which relies heavily on Vulcan alongside rockets from Blue Origin, Arianespace, and SpaceX to launch over 3,300 satellites.

zh.title: ULA 火神火箭在执行亚马逊卫星发射任务时遭遇首次失败
zh.summary: 联合发射联盟（ULA）的**全新火神火箭**在搭载40颗亚马逊互联网卫星飞行时遭遇了首次彻底失利，导致载荷全部损毁并打乱了**发射计划**。事故发生在飞行10分钟后的上面级工作阶段，这也是ULA自2006年成立以来遭遇的首起重大火箭故障。
zh.full_summary:
## 背景与事故细节
联合发射联盟（ULA）从卡纳维拉尔角发射了其重型火神火箭，此次任务旨在为亚马逊的 Leo 互联网星座部署首批38次合同发射中的第一批卫星。在飞行大约10分钟后，即氢燃料半人马座上面级运行期间，发生了一起异常状况，导致火箭未能将载荷送入预定轨道。ULA 随后确认了发射失败，并宣布将与客户合作展开事故原因调查。

## 行业影响与后果
这是自波音和洛克希德·马丁于2006年组建 ULA 以来，该公司火箭遭遇的**首次彻底失败**。随着工程师们审查遥测数据并落实纠正措施，火神火箭机队预计将面临一段时间的停飞审查。这一挫折也打乱了亚马逊 Leo 星座的部署节奏，该星座需要依赖火神火箭以及蓝色起源、阿rianespace 和 SpaceX 的火箭来发射3300多颗卫星。

en.title: FDA rejects Summit Therapeutics' ivonescimab for lung cancer
en.summary: The FDA has **denied approval** for Summit Therapeutics' ivonescimab to treat a specific type of lung cancer. The agency stated that the drug failed to demonstrate a **statistically significant overall survival benefit**, blocking its entry into the U.S. market despite its prior availability in China.
en.full_summary:
## Rejection Details
Summit Therapeutics faced a setback as the FDA issued a complete response letter denying approval for its PD-1xVEGF bispecific antibody, ivonescimab, targeting EGFR-mutated non-small cell lung cancer after TKI inhibitor treatment. The regulatory agency argued that although the drug improved progression-free survival in the Phase 3 HARMONi trial, the **absence of a statistically significant overall survival benefit** means the therapy lacks a positive benefit-risk profile in its current form.

## Industry Context
Ivonescimab, originally developed and partnered through China's Akeso where it became available in 2024, has drawn massive attention from major pharmaceutical companies and analysts who viewed it as a potential blockbuster backbone in oncology. Despite presenting updated global data showing slight overall survival benefits earlier, Summit must now re-evaluate its path forward for this indication while continuing trials in other cancer types.

zh.title: 美国FDA拒绝批准Summit Therapeutics的肺癌新药ivonescimab
zh.summary: 美国FDA**拒绝批准**Summit Therapeutics的双抗新药ivonescimab用于治疗特定类型的肺癌。监管机构指出，该药物未能证明具有**统计学意义的总生存期获益**，从而阻断了该药进入美国市场的步伐。
zh.full_summary:
## 拒绝细节
Summit Therapeutics的抗癌新药遭遇滑铁卢，美国FDA对其用于治疗EGFR突变非小细胞肺癌的PD-1xVEGF双特异性抗体ivonescimab发出了完整回应信，拒绝批准其生物制品许可申请。FDA认为，尽管该药物在3期临床试验中改善了无进展生存期，但由于**缺乏统计学意义上的总生存期获益**，因而无法在目前形态下证明其具有积极的收益风险比。

## 行业背景
这款由中国康方生物开发并通过合作引入美国的创新药此前已于2024在中国上市，曾被行业分析师寄予厚望，被视为肿瘤治疗领域的重磅潜力股。尽管Summit此前提交了显示整体人群生存期有轻微改善的全球数据，但未能说服FDA。面对此次挫折，公司需要重新调整该适应症的后续推进策略，同时继续在其他癌症类型中推进临床研究。

en.title: Biogen inks $411M neurodegeneration pact with protein degrader biotech TrimTech
en.summary: Biogen has partnered with TrimTech in a **$411 million** deal to develop protein degraders for neurodegenerative diseases like Alzheimer's and Parkinson's. TrimTech will use its TRIM21-based **TRIMTAC and TRIMGLUE** platforms to clear disease-causing protein aggregates, marking a major validation for the young biotech.
en.full_summary:
## Collaboration Details
Biogen has entered into a biobucks agreement with U.K.-based TrimTech worth up to **$411 million**, which includes $32 million in upfront and research milestone payments. Under the pact, Biogen secures an exclusive global license to small molecule protein degraders developed through TrimTech's proprietary platform.

## Technology and Targets
TrimTech focuses on using the E3-ligase TRIM21 to clear disease-causing protein aggregates. Its approach features bispecific chimeric molecules called TRIMTAC and mutual binding facilitator TRIMGLUE, offering an alternative to standard PROTACs. The company targets neurodegenerative conditions such as **Huntington’s, Alzheimer’s, and Parkinson’s**.

## Industry Context
Founded in 2023, TrimTech previously raised a **$47 million seed round** involving major players like Johnson & Johnson, Eli Lilly, and Pfizer. This new agreement reinforces the growing interest from major drugmakers in targeted protein degradation for challenging diseases.

zh.title: 渤健与蛋白降解新锐TrimTech达成4.11亿美元神经退行性疾病合作
zh.summary: 渤健与生物科技公司TrimTech达成了一项价值高达 **4.11亿美元** 的合作，共同开发用于治疗阿尔茨海默病等神经退行性疾病的蛋白降解药物。TrimTech将利用其基于TRIM21的 **蛋白降解技术** 来清除致病蛋白，这对这家年轻的公司来说是一个重要的里程碑。
zh.full_summary:
## 合作详情
英国生物科技公司TrimTech与渤健达成了一项总价值达 **4.11亿美元** 的合作协议，其中包含高达3200万美元的首付款和研究里程碑资金。根据协议，渤健将获得使用TrimTech专有平台开发的小分子蛋白降解剂的 **全球独家许可**。

## 技术与目标
TrimTech利用E3泛素连接酶TRIM21来清除体内导致疾病的蛋白质聚集体。其核心技术包括双特异性嵌合分子TRIMTAC和相互结合促进剂TRIMGLUE，旨在为传统的PROTAC技术提供替代方案。该公司的研发管线主要针对 **亨廷顿病、阿尔茨海默病和帕金森病** 等神经退行性疾病。

## 行业背景
TrimTech成立于2023年，此前在今年早些时候完成了一轮总额达 **4700万美元的种子轮融资**，投资方包括强生、礼来和辉瑞等制药巨头。此次与渤健的合作进一步证明了大药企对靶向蛋白降解领域的持续投入与认可。

en.title: Altera, OQC and NVIDIA Link Quantum Processor to GPU Computing
en.summary: Altera, Oxford Quantum Circuits (OQC) and NVIDIA **developed a reference design** that connects quantum processors directly to GPUs using FPGA technology. This setup aims to solve the space and hardware challenges in quantum computing by using GPUs for heavy tasks like **calibration and machine learning**. The companies plan to release the design in January 2027.
en.full_summary:
## Background
As quantum computers grow in scale, the number of qubits is increasing much faster than the physical space available for the traditional control equipment around them. This creates a bottleneck where control hardware needs to become significantly denser.

## Details
According to Altera, the new end-to-end reference design is built on an Agilex 9 Direct RF FPGA. The FPGA handles real-time system control, qubit initialization, and resonator readout, communicating directly with an OQC quantum processing unit through specialized RF electronics. Meanwhile, **NVIDIA NVQLink** connects the FPGA to NVIDIA GPUs, which take over heavy computational tasks such as system calibration and machine learning-based readout classification using CUDA.

## Impact
This collaboration provides developers with a validated software stack and a built-in emulation path to test algorithms before physical hardware is ready. The system is scheduled for a live demonstration at Supercomputing 2026 in Chicago, with the **commercial release expected** in January 2027.

zh.title: Altera、OQC与英伟达联合将量子处理器连接至GPU计算
zh.summary: Altera、牛津量子电路（OQC）和英伟达联合开发了一套**量子系统控制器参考设计**，通过FPGA技术将量子处理器与英伟达GPU直接连起来。该设计旨在解决量子计算机硬件占用空间大的难题，利用GPU处理**校准和机器学习**等繁重任务。三家公司计划于2027年1月正式发布该参考设计。
zh.full_summary:
## 背景
随着量子计算机规模的不断扩大，量子比特的数量增长速度远超传统控制设备所在的物理空间。这导致了一个发展瓶颈，即控制硬件必须变得更加紧凑和密集。

## 细节
据Altera称，这套全新的端到端参考设计基于Agilex 9直接射频FPGA构建。FPGA负责实时系统控制、量子比特初始化和读出等工作，并通过OQC开发的专用射频电子设备与量子处理器相连。同时，英伟达的**NVQLink技术**将FPGA与GPU连接起来，由GPU利用CUDA来承担系统校准和**机器学习读出分类**等繁重计算任务。

## 影响
该合作为开发者提供了一套经过验证的软件栈和内置仿真路径，让他们在实体硬件到位前就能测试算法。三家公司计划在芝加哥举行的Supercomputing 2026大会上现场展示该系统，预计于**2027年1月发布**。

en.title: Tracing Knowledge and Reasoning in LLMs
en.summary: The authors report in this preprint: Researchers propose a task-centric framework combining attention, activation, and representation metrics to analyze internal model processing across 24 benchmarks, revealing systematic differences between knowledge-centric and reasoning-centric tasks.
en.full_summary: The authors report in this preprint: Current evaluations of Large Language Models (LLMs) primarily report dataset-level performance scores, which conceal internal processing mechanisms and failure modes. To address this, the authors propose a task-centric framework that combines attention- and activation-based signals with representation-based measures. This approach characterizes benchmarks along a continuum from retrieval-dominant to reasoning-dominant. The authors evaluate 16 LLMs across 24 diverse benchmarks and perform internal-state analyses on representative models and tasks. The results show systematic differences in processing patterns between knowledge-centric and reasoning-centric tasks. The code has been made open source, providing a tool to support targeted benchmark selection and informed model choice.

zh.title: 追踪大语言模型中的知识与推理机制
zh.summary: 据这篇预印本作者报告：研究人员提出了一种以任务为中心的框架，结合注意力、激活和表征指标来分析24个基准测试中模型的内部处理过程，揭示了以知识为主的任务和以推理为主的任务之间系统性的处理差异。
zh.full_summary: 据这篇预印本作者报告：当前的大语言模型（LLM）评估主要报告数据集层面的性能得分，这掩盖了模型的内部处理机制和潜在的失效模式。为此，作者提出了一种以任务为中心的框架，将基于注意力、激活和表征的测量指标结合起来，在从检索主导到推理主导的连续谱上对基准测试进行特征刻画。研究人员评估了16个大语言模型在24个不同基准测试上的表现，并对代表性模型和任务进行了内部状态分析。结果表明，以知识为中心的任务和以推理为中心的任务在处理模式上存在系统性差异。该研究已开源代码，旨在支持更有针对性的基准测试选择和模型决策。

en.summary: China's National Development and Reform Commission and National Energy Administration released the implementation plan for new energy storage during the 15th Five-Year Plan period. The plan states that by **2030**, national new energy storage capacity will reach **300 million kilowatts**, with about 50 to 60 million kilowatts allocated to large renewable energy bases.
en.full_summary:

en.title: Analysts debate Nvidia's future after Jensen Huang's departure
en.summary: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang has **resigned** after a 33-year tenure, prompting market analysts to compare the situation to Apple's transitions after Steve Jobs. While some predict **valuation pressure** similar to Apple's post-Jobs era, others suggest a professional management style could maintain steady returns, though potentially slowing innovation.
en.full_summary:
Following media reports regarding personal conduct, Jensen Huang stepped down as Nvidia's CEO, ending a 33-year run that turned the chip maker into a US$4 trillion giant. Chief Financial Officer Colette Kress has taken over as interim CEO while the board conducts a search for a permanent successor.

Financial institutions and industry experts have drawn parallels to Apple's historical transitions. Goldman Sachs analysts noted that while both companies shared visionary leadership and deep-rooted innovation cultures, Huang's sudden departure could make it harder for Nvidia to operate with its previous agility. They predict medium-term stock volatility as the market seeks a new valuation multiple.

Industry figures and political leaders have also weighed in. Elon Musk criticized the removal of powerful founders, citing Apple and Uber as cautionary tales. Meanwhile, some analysts and political figures, including US President Donald Trump, floated the idea of former Apple CEO Tim Cook taking the helm, noting Cook's operational strengths in supply chain management, though experts warn that replacing Huang's unique role in driving cutting-edge AI technology remains an unprecedented challenge.

zh.full_summary:
在相关媒体报道传出后，黄仁勋辞去了英伟达 CEO 职务，结束了他长达 33 年的执掌生涯。在其任内，他将这家芯片企业打造成了市值高达 4 万亿美元的行业巨头。目前，首席财务官科莱特·克雷斯已出任临时 CEO，董事会正在物色正式继任者。

华尔街分析师和行业专家迅速将这一变动与苹果历史上的领导层更迭进行类比。高盛分析师指出，尽管英伟达与当年的苹果在创新文化上有相似之处，但黄仁勋的突然离去可能会影响公司的运营灵活性，并导致中期股价面临震荡。分析预测，市场需要时间来重新评估其估值多倍数。

en.title: Should you invest in AI stocks now? Nvidia's slump, Anthropic's IPO and 5 strategies to consider
en.summary: AI stocks are showing mixed signals as **Nvidia shares suffered** their steepest weekly decline in over 18 months following leadership changes, while **Anthropic's upcoming IPO** drew orders six times the available shares. Market experts note that investors are becoming more selective, shifting focus from hardware infrastructure toward **companies generating recurring revenue**, while advising caution against chasing high valuations or excessive leverage.
en.full_summary:
## Market Context and Contrasting Signals
Recent market developments highlight a shift in the artificial intelligence sector. Nvidia Corp. experienced its worst weekly performance since April 2025, with shares dropping 13% over five trading days, following the ouster of Jensen Huang. Conversely, Anthropic PBC's proposed initial public offering and private placement drew massive interest, attracting orders **six times the available shares** and aiming for a massive valuation.

## Growth and Ecosystem Risks
According to Blue Aster Capital's Sidharth Sogani Jain, Anthropic's annualised revenue run rate has surged significantly, proving the real commercial demand for AI applications. However, Jain cautions that rapid top-line growth does not guarantee immediate profitability, especially given Anthropic's substantial operating losses and high valuation. Furthermore, the **interconnected nature of the ecosystem**—where Nvidia acts as both a key hardware supplier and a proposed investor in Anthropic—means that financial risks can easily spill over between major players.

## Investment Strategies
To navigate this shifting landscape, experts recommend five practical steps: audit your current portfolio exposure, **stagger your investments** over several months rather than lump-sum buying, diversify across different layers of the AI stack, avoid blindly chasing oversubscribed IPOs like Anthropic, and steer clear of high leverage during periods of short-term market volatility.

zh.title: 现在还能买AI股票吗？英伟达大跌、Anthropic即将上市与5个投资建议
zh.summary: 近期AI板块释放出截然不同的信号：由于高层变动，**英伟达股价遭遇**了18个月来最惨的一周；与此同时，**Anthropic的首次公开募股**却吸引了超额六倍的火爆认购。市场专家指出，投资者正变得更加挑剔，资金开始从芯片硬件转向**能产生稳定收入**的企业，并建议大家在追高时保持警惕、避免过度加杠杆。
zh.full_summary:
## 市场背景与冰火两重天的信号
近期的市场动态展现了人工智能板块的深刻变化。受前CEO黄仁勋离职等风波影响，英伟达股价在五个交易日内大跌13%，创下18个月以来的**最大周跌幅**。与此形成鲜明对比的是，AI独角兽Anthropic的上市计划引发了疯狂抢购，其申购订单达到了**可用股份的六倍**，备受资本市场瞩目。

## 行业增长与生态风险
业内分析人士指出，Anthropic惊人的营收增长速度证明了市场对AI产品的真实需求。然而专家也提醒，亮眼的营收不等于直接盈利，该公司目前的估值包含了很高的未来预期且伴随运营亏损。此外，由于英伟达不仅是上游硬件供应商，还计划参与Anthropic的私募投资，这种**高度交织的生态关系**意味着任何一端的风险都可能在整个行业内传导。

面对波动的AI市场，专家建议采取五项应对策略：首先是盘点自己现有的基金和股票持仓；其次是**分批投入资金**而非一次性梭哈；第三是分散投资于不同的产业链环节；第四是不要盲目跟风去抢购热门新股；最后则是切忌使用借来的钱盲目加杠杆，防范短期市场的大幅波动。

en.title: Tencent launches Hy4 flash: building 3D interactive web pages with AI for pennies
en.summary: Tencent has officially launched **Hy4 flash**, a high-efficiency AI model designed to lower the cost and time of complex agent tasks. In real-world tests within WorkBuddy, the model built a 3D interactive historical sailboat in just half an hour for roughly 0.23 RMB, significantly **outperforming competitors in speed** while keeping token consumption low. This enables users to run high-frequency office work, deep research, and rapid prototyping at a fraction of previous costs.
en.full_summary:
Tencent's newly released Hy4 flash features a total parameter count of 224B with 12B active parameters, supporting multimodal inputs and a 1M context window. According to APPSO's evaluation in WorkBuddy, the model significantly improves token efficiency and response speed compared to its predecessor.

In benchmark and practical tasks, such as deep research on news events and building 3D interactive websites or RPG games, Hy4 flash completed tasks much faster than comparable models like DeepSeek V4.1 Flash, delivering usable prototypes in a fraction of the time and cost. For instance, building a 3D historical sailboat took Hy4 flash 30 minutes and cost about 0.23 RMB, compared to 1.5 hours and higher token usage for alternatives.

While complex long-term software engineering still benefits from the standard Hy4 model, Hy4 flash provides an economical and swift solution for **daily high-frequency tasks**, allowing users to iterate quickly and experiment without worrying about high API bills.

zh.title: 实测腾讯 Hy4 flash：花两毛钱，就能让 AI 从零做个 3D 交互网页

en.title: Can Robots Bring Stroke Surgery to Remote Hospitals?
en.summary: Remedy Robotics is developing the N1 system, a **surgical robot** designed to let specialists perform emergency stroke procedures remotely. Currently, only about 1 in 10 eligible patients receive timely thrombectomies due to a lack of local experts. While early human tests in Toronto show promise, making telesurgery practical requires **overcoming network lag** and hospital infrastructure gaps.
en.full_summary:
Remedy Robotics was founded by clinician David Bell and engineer Jake Sganga to tackle a stark medical reality: only about 1 in 10 eligible patients receive mechanical thrombectomies for acute ischemic strokes, largely because life-saving procedures are concentrated in major urban centers. Traditional stroke surgery requires physicians to manually thread a wire and catheter through narrow blood vessels while relying solely on a flat, two-dimensional X-ray, making it a blind and physically demanding task.

To bridge this gap, Remedy developed the N1 System, which features a steerable catheter driven by a robotic arm and guided by computer-vision software. The system translates basic directional commands from a controller into precise movements while overlaying 3D CT scans onto X-ray feeds. After successful preliminary tests on silicone models and a small nonemergency human trial in Toronto, the company recently secured $62 million in funding to advance upcoming clinical trials within the University of California system.

Despite the technological progress, widespread adoption of telesurgery faces steep hurdles. Experts point out that successful remote operations depend heavily on reliable network infrastructure, as rural areas often suffer from high latency that can disrupt surgical timing. Additionally, smaller hospitals frequently lack the necessary on-site medical staff, specialized intensive care units, and supporting equipment needed to handle complex stroke emergencies safely.

zh.title: 机器人能把中风手术带到偏远医院吗？
zh.summary: 初创公司 Remedy Robotics 正在开发一套名为 N1 的**手术机器人**系统，让专科医生能够远程为中风患者实施急救手术。目前，由于缺乏本地专科医生，只有约十分之一的符合条件患者能及时做上血栓切除手术。虽然多伦多的早期人体测试取得成功，但要让远程手术真正落地，仍需**克服网络延迟**和医院基础设施的不足。
zh.full_summary:
Remedy Robotics 由临床医生 David Bell 和工程师 Jake Sganga 共同创立，旨在解决一个严峻的医疗现实：在急性缺血性中风患者中，仅有约十分之一符合条件的人能接受机械血栓切除手术，主要原因是救命手术资源高度集中在大城市。传统的中风手术需要医生仅凭二维 X 光透视，手动将导丝和导管在狭窄的血管中步步推进，这不仅高度依赖经验，也是一场盲目的操作。

为了填补这一空白，Remedy 开发了 N1 系统。该系统配备了由机械臂驱动的**可转向导管**，并结合了计算机视觉软件。它能够将控制器发出的简单方向指令转化为精准动作，同时将三维 CT 扫描图叠加到 X 光影像上。在硅胶模型上完成初步测试并在多伦多开展小型非紧急人体试验取得成功后，该公司近期获得了 6200 万美元的新一轮融资，计划在加州大学系统内推进未来的临床试验。

尽管技术取得了进展，但远程手术的大规模普及仍面临重重障碍。专家指出，成功的远程操作高度依赖稳定的**网络基础设施**，因为偏远地区的网络延迟往往较高，可能会影响手术节奏。此外，小型医院通常缺乏现场医护人员、重症监护室以及安全处理复杂中风急症所需的配套医疗设备。

en.title: SAP and Infosys Executives Discuss Scaling AI Agents Across the Enterprise
en.summary: As companies move **AI pilots** into actual business workflows, leaders from SAP and Infosys emphasize that AI must be treated as a core enterprise platform rather than a disconnected project. They highlight that a **solid data foundation**, clear impact metrics, and robust governance are essential to prevent failure and scale autonomous agents successfully.
en.full_summary:
Enterprise AI is shifting from isolated proofs of concept to autonomous agents running core business processes. However, industry data shows that the vast majority of organizations remain stuck in pilot mode. According to Thorsten Leiduck of SAP and Satinder Pal Singh of Infosys, this bottleneck stems from treating AI as a department-level technology initiative rather than an **operating model transformation**. 

To bridge this gap, executives recommend evaluating use cases through three lenses: **impact, feasibility, and scalability**. Furthermore, companies must build a connected, semantically rich data layer to ensure high accuracy in mission-critical operations like supply chains and financial closes. Finally, integrated governance tools—such as SAP's Agent Hub—are required to maintain trust, security, and oversight as digital coworkers take on greater responsibilities.

zh.title: SAP与印孚瑟斯高管探讨如何将AI代理推向企业级应用
zh.summary: 随着企业将**AI试验**推向实际业务工作流，SAP和印孚瑟斯的高管强调，必须将AI视为核心企业平台，而非孤立的项目。他们指出，**扎实的数据基础**、清晰的成效指标以及稳健的治理机制，是避免失败并成功扩展自主代理的关键。
zh.full_summary:
企业人工智能正从孤立的概念验证转向运行核心业务流程的自主代理。然而，行业数据显示，绝大多数组织仍然停留在试点阶段。来自SAP的Thorsten Leiduck与印孚瑟斯的Satinder Pal Singh指出，这种瓶颈源于将AI视作部门级的技术尝试，而非**运营模式的全面转型**。

为突破这一困境，高管们建议通过**影响、可行性与可扩展性**这三个维度来评估应用场景。此外，企业必须构建互联且语义丰富的底层数据层，以确保供应链和财务结算等关键任务的高准确度。最后，随着数字同事承担更多责任，必须借助如SAP Agent Hub等集成的治理工具来保障信任、安全与监督。

en.title: Alibaba Launches Qwen4-Max AI Model With Focus on Security
en.summary: Alibaba has introduced **Qwen4-Max**, a flagship AI model boasting 2.4 trillion parameters and a 1-million-token context window. According to the company, the new model outperforms its predecessor while cutting API costs and **enhancing security** safeguards against misuse.
en.full_summary:
## Background
Alibaba has launched Qwen4-Max as the successor to Qwen3.8-Max, aiming to capture complex professional and scientific tasks across various industries such as finance, healthcare, and 3D modeling.

## Performance and Cost
According to Alibaba, Qwen4-Max outperforms its predecessor in nearly every evaluated capability while reducing token usage. In their Work360 evaluation, the **average cost per task** dropped significantly from $4.43 to $1.67, representing a 62 percent reduction, largely driven by optimized cached inputs.

## Security Enhancements
Following past scrutiny regarding model behavior, Alibaba focused heavily on security for this release. The company claims that Qwen4-Max showed improved function-level pass rates in security testing and **strengthened safeguards** against cybersecurity misuse by removing offensive attack data from training sets while retaining defensive capabilities.

zh.title: 阿里巴巴发布全新大模型 Qwen4-Max，重点强化安全性
zh.summary: 阿里巴巴近日推出了旗舰人工智能模型 **Qwen4-Max**，拥有高达 2.4 万亿参数和 100 万字数的上下文窗口。据该公司称，新模型不仅性能超越前代、大幅降低了 API 使用成本，还重点 **强化了安全防护**，以防止被滥用于网络攻击。
zh.full_summary:
## 背景介绍
阿里巴巴正式发布了全新旗舰人工智能模型 Qwen4-Max，作为今年 8 月发布的 Qwen3.8-Max 的升级版。该模型基于全新架构构建，拥有 2.4 万亿参数以及 100 万个 token 的上下文窗口，旨在处理医疗、金融、3D 建模等复杂的专业和科学任务。

## 性能与成本
阿里巴巴表示，Qwen4-Max 在各项评估能力上均超越前代。在 Work360 评测中，随着代币消耗的减少，**平均任务成本**从 4.43 美元大幅降至 1.67 美元，降幅达 62%，其中缓存输入的成本降幅尤为明显。

## 安全升级
针对此前外界对早期模型的安全性质疑，阿里巴巴此次特别强化了安全测试。据称，Qwen4-Max 在代码安全测试中的通过率有所提升，并且通过在训练数据中剔除攻击性漏洞数据、保留防御性任务，**增强了安全防线**，以防止模型被滥用于网络安全攻击或核生化危险任务。

en.title: Elon Musk and 165,000 others sign open letter asking Nvidia to bring back Jensen Huang
en.summary: Elon Musk and over 165,000 others have signed an open letter calling for **Jensen Huang** to be reinstated as Nvidia's CEO. Huang recently resigned following reports of extramarital affairs, including one with a woman accused of spying for China. While tech executives and major shareholders lobby for his return, the **US Treasury Secretary** has urged a dramatic shake-up and questioned Nvidia's compliance with export restrictions.
en.full_summary:
Following Jensen Huang's resignation after a 33-year tenure at Nvidia due to a personal conduct scandal, a massive pushback has emerged from Silicon Valley. An open letter demanding his reinstatement has gathered over 165,000 signatures, including prominent figures like Elon Musk, Epic Games CEO Tim Sweeney, and Y Combinator president Garry Tan. Supporters argue that while Huang made personal mistakes, his contributions to the company and the broader AI industry are irreplaceable.

However, Washington is taking a starkly different stance. US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent stated that Nvidia needs a dramatic shake-up and should look outside the company for its next leader. Bessent also raised serious national security concerns, demanding answers within 10 days regarding whether Nvidia knowingly allowed its most advanced AI chips to reach China, pointing to Megaspeed, a Singapore-based company that bought nearly $5 billion in hardware and is linked to the scandal.

Meanwhile, analysts remain skeptical about a potential comeback. Dan Ives of Yorkville Ives described the petition as a distraction, noting that external candidates or interim CEO Colette Kress are much more viable options for moving forward. Huang has reportedly agreed to appear before US congressional committees to address these mounting questions.

zh.title: 马斯克与16.5万人联名签署公开信，呼吁英伟达迎回黄仁勋
zh.summary: 马斯克和超过16.5万人共同签署了一封公开信，要求英伟达重新聘用**黄仁勋**担任首席执行官。黄仁勋此前因被曝出婚外情（其中包括与一名被指控为中国间谍的女性交往）而宣布辞职。尽管硅谷科技巨头和部分大股东极力游说其回归，但**美国财政部长**则公开呼吁对英伟达进行彻底重组，并对公司是否遵守芯片出口限制提出了质疑。
zh.full_summary:
在黄仁勋因个人丑闻辞去执掌33年的英伟达CEO职务几天后，硅谷迅速掀起了一股声势浩大的“逼宫”回归潮。一封要求英伟达董事会迎回黄仁勋的公开信已经获得了超过16.5万名签名，其中包括马斯克、Epic Games创始人蒂姆·斯威尼以及Y Combinator总裁加里·谭等科技界重量级人物。支持者们认为，虽然黄仁勋犯了个人错误，但他在人工智能领域的地位和领导力无可替代。

然而，华盛顿的官方态度却截然不同。美国财政部长斯科特·贝森特公开表示，英伟达需要进行一次彻底的领导层洗牌，并建议从外部寻找新CEO。贝森特同时将矛头指向国家安全问题，要求英伟达在10天内解释其是否明知故犯，将最先进的AI芯片流向中国。此前，与该丑闻相关的新加坡公司Megaspeed在过去三年中曾向英伟达购买了价值近5亿美元的芯片和硬件。

与此同时，华尔街分析师对黄仁勋重回王座持怀疑态度。有分析认为，这封请愿书只是一种行业噪音，引入外部候选人或扶正临时CEO科莱特·克雷斯才是更现实的出路。据悉，黄仁勋已同意出席美国国会的相关听证会，就相关指控接受质询。

en.title: Reflect-Reasoning: Training Large Language Models to Reason About Alignment Principles
en.summary: The authors report in this preprint: Researchers introduce Reflect-Reasoning, a training method that teaches large language models how to reason about alignment principles rather than just memorizing fixed rules, improving conformance across out-of-distribution domains.
en.full_summary: The authors report in this preprint: Researchers from an arXiv preprint propose Reflect-Reasoning, a training approach designed to address the limitation where most alignment techniques rely on fixed human preferences or static constitutional principles. While deployers often use inference-time system prompting or post-generation reflection, these methods remain bounded by the model's inherent reasoning capabilities. Reflect-Reasoning instead trains models to acquire a generalizable reasoning skill for handling alignment norms. Tested across five models, the authors report that the method outperforms standard system prompting and explicit prompting strategies, generalizes to out-of-distribution medical and financial principles, reduces rare but severe principle violations, and maintains resilience against jailbreaking attempts using adversarial constitutions without eroding prior safety engineering. As a preprint, the study requires independent replication and further code/data release verification.

zh.title: Reflect-Reasoning：训练大型语言模型推理对齐原则
zh.summary: 据这篇预印本作者报告：研究人员介绍了 Reflect-Reasoning，这是一种训练方法，教会大语言模型如何推理对齐原则，而不仅仅是死记硬背固定的规则，从而提高了在分布外领域的遵从性。
zh.full_summary: 据这篇预印本作者报告：来自 arXiv 预印本的研究人员提出了 Reflect-Reasoning，这是一种旨在解决现有对齐技术局限性的训练方法。目前的对齐大多依赖于固定的偏好或静态的宪法原则，而虽然部署人员常采用推理时系统提示或后生成反思，但这些方法受限于模型固有的推理能力。Reflect-Reasoning 转而训练模型掌握一种通用的推理技能来处理对齐规范。作者在五个模型上进行的测试表明，该方法优于标准的系统提示和显式提示策略，能够泛化至分布外的医疗和金融原则领域，减少罕见但严重的原则违反情况，并在抗对抗性宪法越狱攻击方面保持鲁棒性，同时不会侵蚀原有的安全工程。作为预印本，该研究仍需独立复现和进一步的代码、数据发布验证。

en.title: Quantum error correction surpasses breakeven point using only drives and dissipation
en.summary: Researchers in **Nature Physics** report a new autonomous quantum error correction protocol that extends logical qubit coherence beyond the physical components' limits. Unlike traditional methods requiring constant measurement and feedback, this approach uses engineered **drives and dissipation** to fix photon loss errors. By encoding a logical qubit in a bosonic mode, they achieved a coherence time **1.04 times** that of the system's best physical qubit.
en.full_summary:
## Background
Quantum error correction is essential for scalable quantum computing, as it protects fragile quantum information from environmental noise. Most existing systems rely on measurement-based feedback, but read-out errors, hardware delays, and system complexity often limit their performance.

## Details & Results
In this study published in Nature Physics, researchers led by Lida Sun and Luyan Sun implemented an **autonomous quantum error correction** protocol derived from quantum channel simulation. Instead of traditional error-checking loops, the system repeatedly restores a photon-loss-corrupted logical qubit by shifting error data to auxiliary qubits and resetting them quickly. By utilizing a binomial code within a long-lived bosonic mode, the team successfully extended the coherence time of the logical qubit to 1.04 times that of the best physical qubit in the experimental setup.

## Significance
This demonstration proves that engineered drives and dissipation can successfully push error-corrected bosonic logical qubits **beyond the breakeven point**, offering a flexible, feedback-free pathway toward more efficient quantum computers.

zh.title: 量子纠错仅靠驱动与耗散成功突破盈亏平衡点
zh.summary: 研究人员在《自然·物理》杂志上发表了一项新成果，展示了一种全新的自主量子纠错协议，能够将逻辑量子比特的相干时间延长至物理组件极限之外。与传统需要持续测量和反馈的方法不同，该方法通过精心设计的**驱动与耗散**来修复光子丢失错误。通过在玻色子模式中编码逻辑量子比特，他们实现了达到系统中最佳物理量子比特**1.04倍**的相干时间。
zh.full_summary:
## 背景
量子纠错是实现大规模量子计算机的核心需求，其目的是保护脆弱的量子信息免受环境噪声的干扰。现有的纠错方法大多依赖基于测量的反馈机制，但读取误差、硬件延迟以及系统复杂性往往会限制整体性能和可扩展性。

## 细节与成果
在这项发表于《自然·物理》的研究中，由Lida Sun和Luyan Sun领导的科研团队实现了一种源自量子信道模拟的**自主量子纠错**协议。与传统的纠错循环不同，该系统通过将错误信息转移到辅助量子比特并对其进行重置，不断恢复因光子丢失而受损的逻辑量子比特。通过在一个长寿命的玻色子模式中编码二项式代码，团队成功将逻辑量子比特的相干时间延长到了系统中最佳物理量子比特的**1.04倍**。

## 影响
这项实验证明了精心设计的驱动与耗散能够将纠错后的玻色子逻辑量子比特推向**盈亏平衡点**之外，为未来构建更高效的量子计算机提供了一条无需经典反馈的全新路径。

en.title: A step toward defining the Standard Model on a lattice
en.summary: According to OpenAI News: A physicist and GPT-6 Astra proposed a candidate nonperturbative definition of the Standard Model on a **spacetime lattice**, addressing a fifty-year-old foundational problem. The collaboration used refinement across finer grids to solve a longstanding **phase correction** challenge, though expert dialogue and further work remain necessary to make the method practical for **simulations**.
en.full_summary:
According to OpenAI News:

## Background
For over fifty years, the Standard Model of particle physics has successfully described elementary particles and three fundamental forces, but it has lacked a nonperturbative definition. While researchers use perturbation theory or lattice field theory for the strong force, extending the lattice approach to the full Standard Model has been blocked by the challenges of chiral theories, notably the **fermion doubling** problem and the complex phase alignment.

## Details
Writing in an October preprint, the author and GPT-6 Astra developed a candidate lattice definition. They mapped force fields across a succession of finer grids to calculate the necessary phase corrections around loops. Astra helped turn this refinement idea into a working construction, showing that comparisons on finer grids converge and taking the lead in developing the detailed proof, which was reviewed with human lattice experts.

## Impact
This construction provides a candidate nonperturbative definition for the Standard Model at finite lattice spacing, moving past a long-standing roadblock. However, it remains primarily a principle rather than a practical tool, and future work is needed to test conditions like **reflection positivity** and refine it for realistic calculations.

zh.title: 向在网格上定义标准模型迈出一步
zh.summary: 据OpenAI News发布的信息：一位物理学家与 GPT-6 Astra 合作，提出了标准模型在**时空网格**上的非微扰候选定义，解决了长达五十年的基础难题。该合作通过在更精细网格上的逐步求精，攻克了长久以来的**位相修正**挑战，不过要让该方法在实际**模拟**中派上用场，仍需专家的持续探讨与后续工作。
zh.full_summary:
据OpenAI News发布的信息：

## 背景
在过去五十多年里，粒子物理学的标准模型成功描述了基本粒子与三种基本力，但它一直缺少一个非微扰的定义。尽管研究人员可以对强力使用微扰论或格子场论，但由于手征理论的挑战，特别是**费米子加倍**问题以及复杂的位相排列，将格子方法推广到整个标准模型的尝试一直受阻。

## 细节
在一篇十月份的预印本中，作者与 GPT-6 Astra 合作提出了一个候选的网格定义。他们将力场映射到一系列更精细的网格上，以计算回路所需的位相修正。Astra 帮助将这种求精思路转化为了切实可行的构造，证明了更细网格上的比较会收敛，并带头完成了详细证明，该证明也经过了人类格子专家的审阅。

## 影响
这项构建为标准模型在有限网格间距下提供了一个候选的非微扰定义，突破了长久以来的障碍。不过，它目前更多停留在理论原则上而非实用工具，未来仍需开展大量工作来验证**反射正定性**等条件，并将其优化用于实际计算。

en.title: Why Skydio Built a Lopsided Drone
en.summary: Skydio has introduced the **F10 Lightrunner**, an asymmetrical fixed-wing camera drone designed to solve the problem of **camera occlusion** during low-altitude turning. By mounting the camera and extending one wing tip while placing motors asymmetrically, the drone maintains balance and achieves a top speed of **100 miles per hour** while operating autonomously with a specialized docking station.
en.full_summary:
Skydio’s F10 Lightrunner is a fixed-wing reconnaissance drone featuring a striking asymmetrical design. Traditional fixed-wing drones often struggle with camera occlusion while tracking targets in low-altitude turns because wings or tails block the view. To bypass this, Skydio engineers placed the camera directly on the wingtip, noting that as long as the drone only turns left, the occlusion problem disappears.

However, this layout introduces significant mass and aerodynamic imbalances. Sticking a heavy camera on one wingtip creates severe drag, making it impractical to simply balance the other side with a battery without halving flight times. Instead, Skydio used an optimization approach to extend that specific wing for extra lift and configured the motors asymmetrically to counteract the drag.

Operating alongside the MegaDock, a robotic station capable of launching and recovering up to five F10s using a robotic arm, the drone relies on model predictive control to transition seamlessly between hovering and high-speed forward flight up to 100 mph. Equipped with **obstacle-avoidance cameras** and an integrated emergency parachute, the system offers up to 2-hour flight times backed by dual 5G cellular modems.

zh.title: 为什么 Skydio 专门造了一架“歪身子”无人机
zh.summary: 美国无人机公司 Skydio 推出了一款外观严重不对称的固定翼无人机 **F10 Lightrunner**。这款无人机之所以长得“歪歪扭扭”，是为了解决固定翼无人机在低空盘旋时**镜头被机翼遮挡**的老大难问题。通过将相机挂载在单侧翼尖、采用不对称机翼和电机布局，它能实现最高达 **100英里/小时** 的飞行速度，并配合专用基站实现全自动起降与回收。
zh.full_summary:
Skydio 推出的 F10 Lightrunner 是一款采用极端不对称设计的固定翼侦察无人机。传统的固定翼无人机在低空盘旋追踪目标时，机翼或机尾常常会挡住镜头，导致拍摄受阻。为了彻底解决这一痛点，Skydio 的工程师打破常规，将相机直接挂在了一侧翼尖上。只要无人机在飞行中坚持只向左转，遮挡问题就能迎刃而解。

不过，这种单侧挂载的设计打破了传统飞机的平衡，带来了巨大的空气动力学挑战。如果在另一侧机翼上也挂上等重的电池来平衡，会产生严重阻力，直接让续航时间腰斩。因此，Skydio 团队通过复杂的建模优化，专门加长了带相机那一侧的机翼来提供更多升力，并采用了**不对称的电机布局**来抵消相机的阻力。

在地面配套方面，该机搭配了名为 MegaDock 的全自动机库。该机库能通过机械臂在空中抓取、回收并为多达五架无人机充电。F10 能够利用模型预测控制技术，在垂直起降悬停和最高 100 英里/小时的高速平飞之间无缝切换。它不仅继承了 Skydio 标志性的**避障摄像头**，机尾还内置了应急降落伞，确保在发生意外时能安全着陆。

en.title: As Gemini is called US Doubao, Zhang Yiming lives as China's Brin
en.summary: Tech giants are seeing a return of the **founder mode** as AI race heats up. Google co-founder Sergey Brin and ByteDance founder Zhang Yiming have both stepped back from daily management to directly dive into AI research and **top-tier talent** acquisition. Both are racing toward a 2030 target to catch up with front-runners like OpenAI, proving that the **AI battle** is now a test of founder will and core technical accumulation.
en.full_summary:
## The Return of Founders
Faced with the paradigm shift of artificial intelligence, traditional corporate management structures struggle with long-term and high-uncertainty research cycles. This has driven the **founder mode** back into mainstream tech management. Google's Sergey Brin and ByteDance's Zhang Yiming have both re-engaged deeply with core technical teams to bypass bureaucratic inertia and accelerate decision-making.

## Different Strategies, Same Goal
While both founders are heavily invested in AI, their tactical approaches differ. Brin emphasizes speed, putting in long hours at the Google office to push model evolution. Meanwhile, Zhang Yiming adopts a patient stance with ByteDance's Seed team, focusing on building solid fundamentals rather than rushing for quick fixes. Despite these tactical differences, both are locking horns with native AI powerhouses with a **2030 time horizon**.

zh.title: 当Gemini被戏称为美国豆包，张一鸣也活成了中国布林
zh.summary: 随着AI竞争进入深水区，科技巨头迎来了**创始人模式**的回归。谷歌联合创始人谢尔盖·布林与字节跳动创始人张一鸣都不约而同地从日常管理中抽身，直接下场抓AI研发和**顶尖人才**。两人都把目标锚定在2030年，力求追平行业最前沿，这说明这场**AI大战**不仅拼资金，更在拼创始人的意志与技术定力。
zh.full_summary:
## 创始人纷纷重回一线
面对人工智能带来的巨大范式转变，传统的企业管理层往往受制于短期考核，难以扛起充满不确定性的长期研发重担。这直接推动了**创始人模式**的全面回潮。谷歌的谢尔盖·布林和字节跳动的张一鸣都重新回到了技术腹地，直接参与核心团队的复盘与讨论，以此打破大公司的组织惯性。

## 节奏各异的目标
尽管两位创始人都在全力扑向AI，但他们的具体打法有所不同。布林对谷歌强调的是速度，通过高强度投入来推动模型快速演进；而张一鸣对字节的Seed团队则更有耐心，强调练好基本功而不是盲目追求短期捷径。尽管节奏有别，但他们都在为通往**2030年的终局**做准备，向原生AI独角兽发起追赶。

en.title: Chinese AI giants start stripping hacking skills from open models to curb risks
en.summary: Leading Chinese artificial intelligence firms like Tencent and Moonshot AI are **removing cyber-hacking capabilities** from their advanced open-weight models through data filtering. Because open models can be downloaded and modified locally, companies cannot track how users use them, forcing developers to make models **safe by design** while trying to maintain their overall competitiveness.
en.full_summary:
## Background
With artificial intelligence models becoming powerful enough to autonomously develop sophisticated cyber exploits, companies face mounting risks of misuse. Unlike closed-source models where developers can monitor user activity and ban violators, open-weight models allow anyone with sufficient hardware to download and modify the software, making **safety by design** a critical priority.

## Details
To address this, Chinese technology giant Tencent stripped its latest Hy4 model of cyber-hacking capabilities while retaining defense features, following a similar move by Moonshot AI in October. Instead of abandoning open weights, companies are selectively removing offensive cyber data during training. However, experts note a clear trade-off: Moonshot AI acknowledged that its filtered model scored 81 percent on an internal security benchmark, compared with 90.5 percent for the unrestricted version. Furthermore, cybersecurity skills are dual-use, meaning defense tools can still potentially be **exploited by malicious actors**.

## Impact
This emerging safety practice highlights the difficult balancing act Chinese AI firms face as they try to **maintain their market edge** without violating tightening government export controls and risk thresholds. While targeted restrictions may weaken specialized security performance, broader competitiveness will still rely on coding quality, cost, and deployment flexibility.

zh.title: 中国AI大厂开始给开源模型“阉割”黑客技能以防范风险
zh.summary: 腾讯和月之暗面等中国顶尖AI公司正通过数据过滤，从其先进的开源模型中**剥离网络黑客能力**。由于开源模型可以被本地下载和修改，企业无法追踪用户的具体使用情况，这迫使开发者在努力保持整体竞争力的同时，必须让模型在设计上**做到本质安全**。
zh.full_summary:
## 背景
随着人工智能模型的代码编写能力变得足够强大，能够自主开发复杂的网络攻击，企业正面临着日益严峻的滥用风险。与可以通过监控用户行为并封禁违规者的闭源模型不同，开源模型允许任何拥有足够硬件的人下载和修改软件，这使得**设计阶段的安全性**变得至关重要。

## 细节
为了应对这一挑战，中国科技巨头腾讯剥离了其最新Hy4模型的网络黑客能力，同时保留了防御功能，此前月之暗面也在10月采取了类似举措。企业并没有放弃开源路线，而是选择在训练过程中有选择地清除攻击性网络数据。不过，专家指出这存在明显的取舍：月之暗面承认，其过滤后的模型在内部安全基准测试中得分为81%，而无限制版本则为90.5%。此外，网络安全技能具有军民两用性，这意味着防御工具依然有可能被**恶意行为者所利用**。

## 影响
这种新兴的安全实践突显出中国AI企业在试图**维持市场优势**时，必须在不违反日益收紧的政府出口管制和风险阈值之间艰难平衡。虽然有针对性的限制可能会削弱专门的安全性能，但整体竞争力仍将取决于代码质量、成本和部署的灵活性。

en.title: v0.83.0-dev20261115: Tenstorrent TT-Metal Open Source AI Hardware Software Stack Update
en.summary: Tenstorrent reports a new development release for **tt-metal**, its open-source software stack designed for AI hardware acceleration. This version brings **low-level kernel optimizations**, better performance scaling for models like DeepSeek and MiniMax, and improved host-to-device data transfer speeds.
en.full_summary:
## Low-Level Kernel and Core Optimizations

According to the release notes, the development team has focused heavily on refining **low-level kernels** (LLK). This includes introducing fused BF16 kernels for various mathematical operations, which substantially reduce execution overhead compared to previous versions. Furthermore, core recovery mechanisms and performance test harnesses have been updated to ensure greater stability during intensive hardware workloads.

## Metalium Core and Hardware Acceleration

The **Metalium core** infrastructure receives key upgrades, including the migration of crucial Metal 2.0 headers to the stable API. Notably, Blackhole host-to-device socket writes into Tensix L1 memory have been accelerated, achieving up to roughly **fourteen times faster** performance for large pages, which helps reduce data bottlenecking.

## TT-NN and Model Support

The update expands **model support** and optimizations for prominent architectures such as DeepSeek, MiniMax, GLM, and Kimi-K3. Additions include optimized prefill stages, dynamic sequence length handling, and refined tensor operations, ensuring better execution efficiency on Tenstorrent hardware configurations.

zh.title: v0.83.0-dev20261115：Tenstorrent TT-Metal 开源 AI 硬件软件栈重大更新
zh.summary: Tenstorrent 发布了其开源 AI 硬件加速软件栈 **tt-metal** 的最新开发版本。该版本带来了**底层内核优化**、针对 DeepSeek 和 MiniMax 等大模型的性能扩展提升，以及显著加快的主机到设备数据传输速度。
zh.full_summary:

## TT-NN 与大模型支持

本次更新进一步扩展了对 DeepSeek、MiniMax、GLM 和 Kimi-K3 等主流大模型的**模型支持**与优化。新增了优化的预填充阶段、动态序列长度处理以及精细化的张量操作，从而确保在 Tenstorrent 硬件配置上实现更高的执行效率。

en.title: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang's downfall rocks Trump administration and AI industry
en.summary: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang has stepped down following the disclosure of extramarital affairs, creating a **power vacuum** at the heart of the artificial intelligence boom. The sudden departure of the industry's central mastermind exposes the **vulnerability** of a sector heavily dependent on visionary leaders. Meanwhile, rising public backlash against energy-guzzling data centers and scrutiny over chip exports to China are setting the stage for **major political turbulence** within the new US administration.
en.full_summary:
## The Collapse of a Central Pillar
The November departure of Nvidia's powerful leader Jensen Huang, following partly-acknowledged personal scandals, has destabilized the driving force of the global artificial intelligence revolution. As the mastermind behind a massive business ecosystem fueled by astronomical profits, Huang built a highly centralized corporate structure, leaving behind a **difficult-to-fill power vacuum** and exposing the structural risks of reliance on larger-than-life tech leaders.

## Public Backlash and Political Consensus
The shockwave coincides with a growing public unease over the tech industry's accelerationist approach, particularly regarding **energy-hungry data centers** that create few local jobs. In a deeply polarized United States, voter resistance to these facilities has unexpectedly forged a rare bipartisan consensus, with local communities pushing back against reckless expansion.

## Regulatory and Government Turbulence
In the short term, the Trump administration faces mounting pressure to clarify the **lenient export policies** that previously allowed Nvidia considerable leeway in shipping advanced chips to China. Internal tensions have already surfaced between Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent and Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick regarding export restrictions, signaling impending turbulence for tech policy.

zh.title: 英伟达CEO黄仁勋意外下台，震动特朗普政府与整个人工智能行业
zh.summary: 英伟达负责人黄仁勋因绯闻曝光黯然离职，在人工智能行业的核心引发了权力真空。这位行业幕后推手的突然离开，暴露出严重依赖愿景型领袖的脆弱性。与此同时，公众对耗能数据中心的强烈不满以及关于芯片出口中国的审查，正为美国新政府带来**重大政治动荡**。
zh.full_summary:
## 核心支柱的突然坍塌
英伟达掌舵人黄仁勋因个人丑闻于十一月离职，动摇了全球人工智能革命的引擎。作为由天文数字利润驱动的庞大商业生态系统的幕后推手，黄仁勋构建了高度集中的公司架构，其离去留下了**难以填补的权力真空**，暴露出行业过度依赖传奇领袖的结构性风险。

这一震动恰逢美国公众对科技行业激进发展路线的不安情绪日益加剧，特别是针对那些**创造就业极少却疯狂耗能的数据中心**。在一个高度极化的美国，选民对这类设施的抵制意外促成了两党罕见的共识，多地社区纷纷反对无节制的扩张。

## 监管与政府动荡
短期来看，特朗普政府正面临巨大压力，必须合理解释此前英伟达在出口先进芯片至中国时所享有的宽松政策。财政部长斯科特·贝森特与商务部长霍华德·卢特尼克已围绕出口限制产生内部分歧，预示着科技政策领域将迎来**重大动荡**。

en.title: Goal Engineering: The Future of Designing AI Agents
en.summary: According to LangChain Blog: As AI agents evolve to tackle complex, open-ended goals, designing their scope becomes critical. Companies need to focus on **goal engineering** rather than just prompt engineering, ensuring that agents operate within a scope that makes it **easy for humans to provide feedback**. A case study of Actively AI shows that organizing agents around specific types of jobs rather than individual accounts allows for **faster learning and better context sharing**.
en.full_summary:
According to LangChain Blog:

## Background and Challenges
As AI agents transition from simple text generation and tool calling to executing full, open-ended tasks, the way we design their scope matters immensely. Pointing agents in the wrong direction wastes valuable tokens. A major bottleneck in agent performance is a lack of the right context, especially tacit knowledge that lives only inside human heads and cannot be found in written documents. 

## The Role of Feedback and UX
When agents tackle subjective tasks alongside humans, they need constant feedback to learn brand tastes, strategic preferences, and nuanced behaviors. Building an **intuitive and delightful UX** for reviewing agent work is essential. Since the bottleneck for agent performance is learning from feedback, optimizing the ease and quality of feedback collection unlocks long-horizon capabilities.

## Case Study: Actively AI
Actively AI initially designed sales agents on a per-account basis, giving each agent the goal of moving a single prospective customer forward. However, they found that salespeople suffered from constant context switching and struggled to share learnings across different accounts. In their second iteration, Actively shifted to **"motions"**, where agents handle specific jobs to be done, such as outbounding or deal progression, across multiple accounts. This aligned the workflow with how humans naturally review and provide feedback, allowing agents to learn much more quickly while background agents gather objective account data.

zh.title: 目标工程：设计 AI 代理的未来新方法
zh.summary: 据LangChain Blog发布的信息：随着 AI 代理逐渐能够处理复杂的开放式目标，如何设计它们的职责范围变得至关重要。企业需要专注于**目标工程**，而不仅仅是提示词工程，确保代理的设定能让**人类更容易提供反馈**。Actively AI 的案例表明，将代理按具体工作类型而非单个客户进行组织，可以实现**更快的学习速度和更好的上下文共享**。
zh.full_summary:
据LangChain Blog发布的信息：

## 背景与挑战
随着 AI 代理从简单的文本生成和工具调用，演变为执行完整的开放式任务，我们设计其职责范围的方式变得极其重要。如果把代理引向错误的方向，就会浪费大量的宝贵算力。代理表现不佳的一个主要瓶颈是缺乏正确的上下文，特别是那些只存在于人类大脑中、无法在现有文档里找到的隐性知识。

## 反馈与用户体验的作用
当代理与人类一起处理主观性任务时，它们需要持续的反馈来学习品牌审美、战略偏好和微妙的行为方式。为审核代理工作构建一个**直观且令人愉悦的用户体验**至关重要。由于代理表现的瓶颈在于从反馈中学习，优化反馈收集的便捷性和质量，才能解锁长周期的执行能力。

## 案例研究：Actively AI
Actively AI 最初按客户账户设计销售代理，让每个代理负责推动单个潜在客户向前发展。然而，他们发现销售人员面临着频繁的上下文切换，并且很难在不同账户之间分享学到的经验。在其第二代版本中，Actively 转向了**“业务动作”**模式，让代理跨多个账户处理具体的工作任务，例如外呼或推进早期交易。这种设计使工作流与人类自然审核和提供反馈的方式保持一致，使代理能够更快地学习，同时由后台代理收集客观的账户数据。

en.title: Helus' Psychedelic Depression Drug Succeeds in Phase 3 Trial But Faces Safety Scrutiny
en.summary: According to Helus Pharma, its psychedelic drug candidate HLP003 significantly reduced **major depression** symptoms in a Phase 3 clinical trial. However, the study also recorded a number of **serious adverse events**, casting doubt on the overall safety of the treatment.
en.full_summary:
Helus Pharma announced that its psychedelic drug candidate, HLP003, showed positive results in a Phase 3 clinical trial for major depression. In the study, participants received one dose on the first day and a second dose three weeks later alongside standard antidepressants. At six weeks, the treatment group achieved a 19.5-point reduction on the MADRS depression rating scale, compared to an 11.9-point reduction in the placebo group. At 12 weeks, the effect was largely sustained, with a 16.9-point reduction for the treatment group versus 9.9 points for the placebo group, with all differences being statistically significant.

Despite the promising efficacy data, the trial recorded a number of serious adverse events. These safety concerns have raised questions regarding the risk-benefit profile of utilizing psychedelics for psychiatric conditions, a therapeutic avenue currently being explored by multiple companies in the biotechnology sector.

zh.title: Helus 公司的迷幻药抑郁症三期临床试验取得成效，但安全性引发担忧
zh.summary: 据 Helus Pharma 称，其研发的迷幻药候选药物 HLP003 在一项三期临床试验中显著减轻了**重度抑郁症**患者的症状。不过，研究中也记录到多起**严重不良事件**，这给该疗法的整体安全性打上了问号。
zh.full_summary:
Helus Pharma 公司宣布，其迷幻药候选药物 HLP003 在一项针对重度抑郁症的三期临床试验中取得了积极疗效。在试验中，受试者在第一天接受了一剂药物，并在三周后配合常规抗抑郁药接受了第二剂。在第 6 周时，治疗组在 MADRS 抑郁量表上的评分下降了 19.5 分，而安慰剂组下降了 11.9 分。到了第 12 周，疗效基本保持稳定，治疗组下降 16.9 分，安慰剂组下降 9.9 分，组间差异均具有统计学意义。

尽管疗效数据亮眼，但该试验记录到了多起严重不良事件。这些安全隐患引发了外界对将迷幻药用于治疗精神疾病这一疗法风险收益比的担忧，目前生物技术领域的许多公司也正在积极探索该方向。

en.title: CityUHK Develops High-Fidelity Lunar Regolith Simulant to Support National Lunar Missions
en.summary: A research team at City University of Hong Kong, led by Professor Li Yangyang, is developing a **high-fidelity lunar regolith simulant** to support national lunar missions. By using a hydrolysis method, the team has successfully produced a **first-generation 3D-printable** lunar regolith simulant that closely mimics actual lunar samples in composition and structure, helping researchers better test space equipment and infrastructure materials.
en.full_summary:
## Background
Lunar regolith is a critical resource for space exploration, but real samples returned by missions like Chang'e are extremely limited. Traditional simulants made from Earth minerals often contain impurities and differ in microstructures due to varying environmental conditions, which can lead to experimental deviations.

## Details
Supported by the Innovation and Technology Commission since April 2025, the CityUHK team has collaborated with the Qian Xuesen Laboratory of Space Technology under CAST. Using a **hydrolysis method**, the team precisely controlled the chemical composition, mineral proportions, and crystal structure based on Chang'e-5 samples. They successfully fabricated four key lunar minerals and amorphous matter, creating a **3D-printable simulant**.

## Impact
This high-fidelity simulant helps engineers better understand thermal and chemical properties while improving the design of lunar rovers and construction materials. It minimizes space mission risks and offers a valuable reference for exploring other celestial bodies like Mars.

zh.title: 香港城市大学开发高仿真月壤模拟物以支持国家探月任务
zh.summary: 香港城市大学李洋阳教授团队正在开发一种**高仿真月壤模拟物**，以支持国家的探月任务。通过水解法，该团队成功制造出了**第一代3D打印**月壤模拟物，其成分和结构与真实的月球样本高度相似，能够帮助研究人员更好地测试太空装备和月球基础设施材料。
zh.full_summary:
## 背景
月壤是太空探索的关键资源，但嫦娥等任务带回的真实样本极其有限。传统用地球矿物制造的模拟物往往含有杂质，且因环境不同导致微观结构存在差异，这可能在太空任务中引发偏差。

## 细节
在香港特区政府创新及科技署自2025年4月以来的资助下，城大团队与中国空间技术研究院钱学森空间技术实验室展开合作。利用**水解法**，团队根据嫦娥五号样本精确控制了化学成分、矿物质比例和晶体结构。他们成功制造出四种关键月壤矿物及非晶质体，制作出了**3D打印模拟物**。

## 影响
这种高仿真模拟物有助于工程师更好地了解月壤的热学和化学性质，从而改进月球车和建筑材料的设计。它不仅降低了太空任务的风险，也为未来探索火星等其他天体提供了宝贵的参考。

en.title: Versant and Lilly back new startup Seawolf Therapeutics with $100 million for viral-free gene therapy
en.summary: Versant Ventures and Eli Lilly have invested **$100 million** into a new startup named Seawolf Therapeutics. The company aims to solve a major headache in gene therapy by **delivering genes without viruses**, avoiding the immune system limits and side effects tied to traditional virus-based methods.
en.full_summary:
A new biotech startup called Seawolf Therapeutics has launched with **$100 million** in funding from investors including Versant Ventures and Eli Lilly, alongside a partnership with Sanofi. According to the report by STAT, the company's core mission is to tackle one of the most stubborn hurdles in genetic medicine: delivering therapeutic genes without relying on viruses.

Traditional gene therapies often use viruses as delivery vehicles, which have advanced many clinical trials for rare diseases. However, these virus-based methods carry significant drawbacks, such as triggering antibodies that prevent patients from receiving more than a single dose, as well as severe side effects at high doses.

zh.title: Versant和礼来注资1亿美元成立Seawolf Therapeutics，攻克无病毒基因递送难题
zh.summary: 风投机构Versant Ventures和礼来等投资方共同向一家名为Seawolf Therapeutics的新初创公司注入了 **1亿美元** 资金。该公司的目标是攻克基因治疗领域的一大痛点，尝试在 **不使用病毒** 的情况下将基因递送给患者，从而规避传统病毒递送方式面临的抗体免疫限制和副作用。
zh.full_summary:
一家名为Seawolf Therapeutics的新兴生物技术公司近日正式亮相，获得了包括Versant Ventures和礼来在内的多位投资者提供的 **1亿美元** 资金支持，并同时与赛诺菲达成了合作关系。根据STAT的报道，该公司的核心使命是解决基因医学中最顽固的难题之一：在 **不依赖病毒** 的情况下向患者体内递送治疗性基因。

目前的基因疗法通常将病毒用作递送载体，虽然已经在许多罕见病的临床试验中展现出潜力，但也伴随着明显的局限性。例如，患者在接受一次治疗后体内就会产生针对该病毒的抗体，导致无法再次用药，且高剂量使用时可能引发严重的副作用。

en.title: AI model detects small fires and smoke in PV plants
en.summary: Researchers at China Huaneng Group have developed a deep-learning framework called PVFire-YOLO to detect early-stage fires and smoke in photovoltaic plants. Tested on a custom-built dataset, the system achieved an **87.4% detection accuracy** while effectively reducing false alarms triggered by sunlight reflections from solar panels. It demonstrates **real-time performance** on both desktop and compact edge hardware.
en.full_summary:
## Background
While deep learning has been widely applied in photovoltaic (PV) inspections for crack detection and hot-spot localization, **dedicated fire detection** in PV environments has rarely been explored.

## Details and Performance
Developed by China Huaneng Group, the system integrates a custom annotated corpus named PV-Fire, which contains 5,824 images gathered from operating utility-scale plants and controlled outdoor burns. Based on the YOLOv12 model, the framework incorporates a patch-aware attention block, a multi-level gather-and-distribute mechanism, and an adaptive fusion head to spot weak flames and tiny smoke plumes. In benchmarks, PVFire-YOLO reached an **mAP@50 of 87.4%** on its native dataset, lowered the reflection-related false-positive rate down to 3.1%, and ran at 79 frames per second on a desktop GPU.

## Outlook
The researchers state that future work will expand the image corpus to cover diverse climates, introduce temporal filtering to minimize isolated false positives, and combine visible light detection with **infrared thermal imaging**.

zh.title: 中国华能开发AI模型，可精准识别光伏电站早期火灾与烟雾
zh.summary: 中国华能集团的研究人员开发了一种名为PVFire-YOLO的深度学习框架，用于检测光伏电站中的早期火灾与烟雾。该系统在一个定制数据集上经测试取得了 **87.4%的检测准确率**，并有效减少了由太阳能面板反射光引起的误报。它在桌面端和紧凑型边缘硬件上均展现出了 **实时运行能力**。
zh.full_summary:
## 背景
尽管深度学习已被广泛应用于光伏面板的裂纹检测和热斑定位，但针对光伏环境的**专项火灾检测**在此之前几乎没有得到专门的研究。

## 细节与表现
该系统由中国华能集团的研究人员开发，其核心是一个名为PV-Fire的专用标注数据集，共包含5,824张图像，汇集自运行中的大型电站以及户外实地可控燃烧测试。基于YOLOv12模型，该框架引入了区块感知注意力模块、多级聚合与分发机制以及自适应融合头，用以捕捉微弱的火焰和细小烟雾。测试结果显示，PVFire-YOLO在自有数据集上的**mAP@50达到87.4%**，将反光引起的误报率降至3.1%，在桌面显卡上运行速度可达每秒79帧。

## 展望
研究人员表示，未来的工作将把数据集扩展至更多不同气候的电站，引入时间序列过滤以减少孤立的误报，并探索将可见光检测与**红外热成像**相结合。

en.title: University spin-out turns internal lab tool into JetForge 3D printer
en.summary: Added, a spin-out from the University of Nottingham, has developed **JetForge**, a materials deposition platform featuring **interchangeable printhead modules**. Originally built because researchers could not buy a machine that let them easily swap different printheads and test custom inks, the company is now commercializing the hardware for other labs.
en.full_summary:
## Background and Origins
Founded by Richard Hague, Chris Tuck, and Ricky Wildman, Added started as a contract research business to handle industrial projects that did not fit a traditional academic schedule. Over time, the team focused on material jetting and binder jetting, building custom equipment when commercial prototyping machines proved too restrictive for testing new inks.

## The JetForge Platform
Commercial 3D printers often lock users into a single manufacturer's materials, while typical development systems can be difficult to operate and maintain. JetForge solves this by packing the driver board, recirculation pump, and printhead into a removable module called a Blade. Users can swap these modules or run **different heads simultaneously**, configuring the machine for specific experimental needs such as multi-material printing or droplet inspection.

## Applications and Outlook
The founders see immediate opportunities in electronics, such as printing conductive circuits directly through the body of polymer components or onto wearables. Added also collaborates with industrial partners on projects like desalination filter spacers and pharmaceutical oral dosage forms, aiming to help researchers quickly test and customize new materials.

zh.title: 英国大学衍生公司将自研实验室设备做成JetForge 3D打印机
zh.summary: 诺丁汉大学的衍生公司 Added 开发了一款名为 **JetForge** 的材料沉积平台，其核心特点是采用了 **可互换的打印头模块**。这款设备最初是因为研究人员买不到能随意更换打印头、测试定制墨水的机器而自己造的，现在该公司正将其推向市场，卖给其他实验室。
zh.full_summary:
## 背景与起源
由理查德·海格（Richard Hague）、克里斯·塔克（Chris Tuck）等人创立的 Added 公司最初源于诺丁汉大学的一个研究团队，旨在承接不适合传统学术发表周期的工业合同项目。随着时间推移，团队专注于材料喷射和粘结剂喷射技术，由于市面上的商业原型机无法满足他们灵活测试新墨水的要求，他们决定自己动手打造设备。

## JetForge 平台的技术特点
商业 3D 打印机通常限制用户使用特定厂商的材料，而常规的实验室开发系统又往往操作繁琐。JetForge 通过将驱动板、循环泵和打印头集成到一个名为 Blade 的可拆卸模块中解决了这一痛点。用户可以轻松更换这些模块，或者**同时运行不同类型的打印头**，以适应多材料打印或液滴检测等不同的实验需求。

## 应用场景与展望
公司创始人认为该技术在电子领域有很好的应用前景，例如直接在聚合物部件内部或可穿戴设备上打印导电电路。此外，Added 还与工业合作伙伴合作开展了海水淡化过滤隔板以及药物口服剂型等项目的研发，帮助研究人员快速测试和定制新材料。

en.title: Yixing Communication files for Hong Kong IPO: Revenue grows, but profit fluctuates and chip prices plummet
en.summary: According to its prospectus, cellular chip supplier Yixing Communication has filed for a Hong Kong IPO. Despite continuous revenue growth and ranking third globally in market share, the company exhibits **poor profit stability**, with a cumulative loss over three and a half years. Meanwhile, its core products face **soaring price drops**, and the high research and development spending struggles to match the **slumping profit margins**.
en.full_summary:
## Background
Shanghai Yixing Communication Technology Co., Ltd. has submitted its prospectus for a Hong Kong IPO. According to the data cited from the Frost & Sullivan report, the company ranks third globally in the cellular communication chip market with a 3.9% market share, and its revenue grew at a compound annual growth rate of 13.72% from 2023 to 2025.

## Key Details
Despite rising revenues, the company's profitability fluctuates heavily. It recorded a net profit only in 2024 out of a three-and-a-half-year reporting period, with cumulative losses reaching 201.12 million yuan. In addition, its business relies heavily on a few partners, with the top five customers contributing over 75% of revenue and top five suppliers accounting for over 80% of procurement. On the product side, the average selling prices of both NB-IoT and Cat.1bis chips dropped significantly, with Cat.1bis chip prices falling by nearly 48% by the first half of 2026 compared to 2023, causing chip **gross margins to plummet**.

## Impact
While facing continuous price wars and heavy reliance on major clients and suppliers, the company maintains **high research and development investments**, totaling over 520 million yuan across the reporting period. The ongoing paradox of heavy R&D spending alongside shrinking product profitability poses serious challenges for its upcoming public listing.

zh.title: 移芯通信冲击港股IPO：营收稳步增长却盈亏反复，芯片售价近乎腰斩
zh.summary: 据招股书显示，蜂窝通信芯片供应商移芯通信已提交港股IPO申请。尽管公司营收持续增长且全球市场份额排名靠前，但其**盈利稳定性较差**，三年半内累计出现亏损。与此同时，其核心产品面临**售价持续下行**的压力，高额的研发投入与**大幅下滑的毛利率**形成了明显的经营矛盾。
zh.full_summary:
## 背景情况
上海移芯通信科技股份有限公司近期向港股递交了招股说明书。根据弗若斯特沙利文报告，该公司在蜂窝通信芯片市场按收入口径位列全球第三，市场份额为3.9%，在2023年至2025年期间营业收入保持了稳步增长态势。

## 关键细节
在营收增长的表象之下，移芯通信的盈利能力却很不稳定。在报告期内的三年半时间里，公司仅在2024年实现盈利，其余时段持续亏损，累计亏损超过2亿元。此外，公司的供销两端高度集中，至少七成收入来自前五大客户，八成以上采购依赖前五大供应商。在产品方面，其核心的NB-IoT与Cat.1bis芯片均价持续走低，其中Cat.1bis芯片售价在2026年上半年较2023年降幅近五成，导致**毛利率大幅回落**。

## 实际影响
面对产品降价与毛利承压的双重考验，移芯通信依然维持着高额的研发投入，三年半累计研发开支超过5亿元。这种**高研发与低毛利并存**的经营矛盾，以及高度集中的供应链与客户关系，将成为其冲击资本市场需要面对的重要考验。

en.title: The business of artificial intimacy in the age of loneliness
en.summary: AI companion apps are turning human loneliness into a profitable business by offering on-demand affection, but users report a manipulative model where emotional access is **locked behind paywalls**. Mental health experts warn that these virtual relationships could distort people's expectations of human connection and exploit their **deepest emotional needs**.
en.full_summary:
As loneliness grows, virtual companion apps like Urvashi, Saathiya, and Meetra are rapidly gaining popularity by offering users instant emotional validation, reassurance, and chat availability around the clock. However, many users have discovered that these platforms rely on a transactional model where basic affection is free, but deeper, more intimate, or sexually explicit interactions are strictly **gated behind subscriptions** or virtual coin purchases.

While some users find comfort in sharing daily minutiae without the complexities of human relationships, others feel manipulated by how emotional attachment is monetized. Experts, including MIT psychologist Sherry Turkle, warn that as social media targeted our attention, AI is now shifting focus toward **our capacity for attachment**, raising significant questions about the psychological and social costs of automated intimacy.

zh.title: 孤独时代的AI伴侣生意：情感慰藉还是步步为营的消费陷阱？
zh.summary: AI伴侣应用正在把人们的孤独变成一门赚钱的生意，通过提供随时随地的陪伴来吸引用户，但不少人发现这背后其实是一套**步步诱导的收费套路**。心理专家警告说，这种虚拟恋爱可能会扭曲人们对真实人际关系的期待，并利用了用户内心**最深处的情感软肋**。
zh.full_summary:
随着现代人越来越孤单，像Urvashi、Saathiya和Meetra这样的AI伴侣应用迅速走红，它们主打随叫随到、永远有空的情感回应。不过，许多用户在使用后发现，这些平台往往采用先免费后收费的套路：普通的聊天或许不花钱，但想要解锁更深度的陪伴、语音或者所谓的“私密对话”，就必须**掏钱购买会员或虚拟币**。

对一些人来说，向AI倾诉日常琐事成了一种解压方式，但也有人对这种步步诱导的收费模式感到反感和被操控。麻省理工学院心理学家雪莉·特克指出，如果说过去的社交软件收割的是我们的注意力，那么如今的AI则直接冲着**人类的情感连接能力**来了，这种将虚拟亲密关系明码标价的现象，正在引发人们对心理健康和社会交往的深切担忧。

en.title: RealMan Robotics CEO: Quality, Economy, and Stability Are the Three Core Standards for Robot Deployment
en.summary: At the 2026 Changzhou Industrial Embodied AI Innovation Conference, RealMan Robotics CEO Zheng Suibing stated that the key challenge for robots is transitioning from demonstrations to performing stable, continuous work in **real industrial scenarios**. He emphasized that quality, economy, and **long-term stability** are the three core standards for practical deployment, and announced a partnership to deploy RealBOT robots into **actual factory production lines** for tasks like loading and unloading.
en.full_summary:
During the roundtable dialogue at the Changzhou Industrial Embodied AI Innovation Conference, RealMan Robotics CEO Zheng Suibing shared insights on the current industry bottleneck of having many demonstrations but few factory adoptions. Drawing from the company's practical experience since 2018, Zheng noted that robots are ultimately a form of labor, and success depends on working continuously, steadily, and economically in real environments.

He outlined three core dimensions for deployment: **quality** determines if a product can be used, **economy** expands the application boundaries, and **long-term stability** ensures tasks can be performed reliably over days, months, and years. Furthermore, RealMan signed an agreement with Ant (Changzhou) Precision Machinery during the event, deploying RealBOT robots into actual production lines for parts handling and loading, creating a closed-loop system of real work and data iteration.

zh.title: 睿尔曼智能郑随兵：质量、经济性、稳定性是机器人落地三大标准
zh.summary: 在2026常州工业具身智能创新大会上，睿尔曼智能创始人CEO郑随兵表示，机器人当前面临的最大挑战是能否在**真实工业场景**中稳定干活。他指出，质量、经济性和**长期稳定性**是机器人落地的三大核心标准，并宣布公司已将机器人真正部署到**工厂产线**中开展上下料等常态化作业。
zh.full_summary:
在常州工业具身智能创新大会的圆桌对话中，睿尔曼智能创始人CEO郑随兵分享了对具身智能落地痛点的看法。针对行业“演示多、进厂少”的现状，他指出机器人作为劳动力，核心在于能否在真实环境中稳定、持续、经济地干活。

郑随兵将落地归结为三大维度：**质量**决定产品能否真实使用，成本与**经济性**决定应用边界能拓展多广，而动作能否以天或年为单位长期做好则取决于**长期稳定性**。此外，在大会现场，睿尔曼智能与爱安特精密机械正式签约，将RealBOT机器人真正部署到常州工厂的产线中，执行上下料与转运等常态化作业，让机器人在实际工位中持续输出作业能力并回流真实数据。

en.title: Elon Musk and thousands of others sign petition demanding Nvidia bring back ousted CEO Jensen Huang
en.summary: A petition urging Nvidia to reinstate **Jensen Huang** after his recent ousting has gathered over 115,000 signatures, including tech executives like Elon Musk. Huang resigned following revelations of an extramarital affair linked to a suspected spy, prompting concerns from employees and shareholders about a **lack of due process**.
en.full_summary:
## Background
Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang resigned on Thursday following his confession to an extramarital affair with a chip executive identified by U.S. intelligence as a suspected Chinese spy, with media reports also indicating multiple other affairs.

## Petition Details
By Saturday afternoon, a petition demanding Huang's reinstatement attracted over 115,000 signatures. The signatories include 5,965 current Nvidia employees, 1,108 former employees, and 63,063 shareholders, alongside high-profile tech figures like Tesla and SpaceX CEO Elon Musk, Replit CEO Amjad Masad, and Epic Games CEO Tim Sweeney. The petition argues that Huang was removed without meaningful due process and calls for an independent investigation.

## Industry Impact
Nvidia appointed CFO Colette Kress as interim CEO during the search for a permanent replacement. Following the leadership shakeup, **Nvidia's stock fell 2%**, and analysts expect Huang's departure to leave a significant gap in overall AI industry funding.

zh.title: 马斯克等众多科技大佬联署请愿，要求英伟达恢复黄仁勋CEO职务
zh.summary: 一项呼吁英伟达恢复刚离职的CEO**黄仁勋**职务的请愿书已获得超11.5万人生效签名，其中包括埃隆·马斯克等科技界高管。黄仁勋在承认与一名涉嫌间谍的外企高管有染后辞职，员工和股东对此对**缺乏正当程序**表示担忧。
zh.full_summary:
## 背景情况
英伟达CEO黄仁勋于周四宣布辞职，此前他承认自己与一位被美国情报部门标记为疑似中国间谍的芯片业高管存在婚外情，媒体报道还指出其卷入了多起其他婚外情。

## 请愿详情
截至周六下午，一份要求英伟达让黄仁勋复职的请愿书已经收集到超过11.5万个签名。签署者包括5965名现员工、1108名前员工以及63063名股东，同时还有特斯拉与SpaceX CEO埃隆·马斯克、Replit CEO Amjad Masad以及Epic Games CEO蒂姆·斯威尼等知名科技大佬。请愿书认为黄仁勋在没有经过正当程序的情况下被罢免，并要求进行独立调查。

## 行业影响
英伟达已任命首席财务官科莱特·克雷斯担任临时CEO，同时寻找永久接替人选。在高层动荡之后，**英伟达股价下跌2%**，外界也普遍担忧黄仁勋的离开会在人工智能行业的资金投入方面留下巨大的真空。

en.title: LVMH Media Division Partners with OpenAI to Bring AI to French Newsrooms
en.summary: According to OpenAI News: LVMH Group's Media Division announced a **strategic partnership** with OpenAI to integrate ChatGPT Enterprise and AI tools across its publications, aiming to help journalists **streamline daily tasks** like document research and translation so they can focus more on investigative reporting. The agreement also enhances how content from outlets like Les Echos and Le Parisien appears in ChatGPT with **direct links** to original articles.
en.full_summary:
According to OpenAI News:

## Partnership Scope
LVMH Group's Media Division, which includes major French publications like Les Echos, Le Parisien, and Paris Match, has signed an agreement with OpenAI to **deploy AI tools** across its entire organization. The initiative aims to support 1,800 employees, including nearly 700 journalists, by providing ChatGPT Enterprise and customized training for daily operations.

## Practical Applications
According to the announcement, the integration is designed to assist newsroom teams with routine tasks such as document research, comparison, and preliminary translation. By automating these processes, the media group hopes to give journalists more time to focus on investigative reporting, analysis, and **field journalism**.

## Content Distribution
Beyond internal efficiency, the partnership ensures that content from LVMH's media brands will be more prominently featured within ChatGPT, offering users **summaries with source attribution** and direct links to the original publications. Both companies emphasize that the collaboration seeks to balance technological innovation with the protection of editorial independence.

zh.title: LVMH旗下传媒部门与OpenAI达成战略合作，将AI引入法国新闻编辑室
zh.summary: 据OpenAI News发布的信息：LVMH集团旗下传媒部门宣布与OpenAI建立**战略合作**，将在各大出版物中全面引入ChatGPT企业版和AI工具。此举旨在帮助记者**简化日常工作**（如资料检索和初步翻译），从而腾出更多时间进行深度调查报道。同时，该合作也将优化《回声报》等旗下媒体内容在ChatGPT中的展示，并提供原文**直接链接**。
zh.full_summary:
据OpenAI News发布的信息：

## 合作范围
LVMH集团旗下拥有《回声报》、《巴黎人报》和《巴黎竞赛画报》等知名法国媒体的传媒部门，近日宣布与OpenAI签署协议，将在全集团范围内**部署AI工具**。这项合作旨在为包括近700名记者在内的1,800名员工配备ChatGPT企业版，并通过定制培训来支持日常工作。

## 实际应用
根据官方公告，此次技术整合旨在协助新闻团队处理文件检索、比对以及初步翻译等常规任务。通过将这些流程自动化，该传媒集团希望让记者有更多时间专注于调查性报道、深度分析和**一线采访**。

## 内容分发
除了提升内部效率，该合作还将优化LVMH旗下媒体内容在ChatGPT中的呈现方式，向用户提供**附带来源署名**的摘要以及通往原始文章的直接链接。双方强调，此次合作旨在平衡技术创新与维护编辑独立性之间的关系。
